jilaton.module.block_outline.name: Block Outline
jilaton.module.block_outline.description: Violet glowing outline of the targeted block, gliding between blocks.
jilaton.module.low_fire.name: Low Fire
jilaton.module.low_fire.description: Violet fire overlay that sits lower so the view and hotbar stay clear.
jilaton.module.radiance.name: Radiance
jilaton.module.radiance.description: Soft blurred glow around players, mobs and items.
jilaton.module.afterglow.name: Afterglow
jilaton.module.afterglow.description: Entities dissolve into rising texel shards when they die.
jilaton.module.weather.name: Weather
jilaton.module.weather.description: Glassy rain, settling snow or an ember shower around the player.
jilaton.module.wings.name: Wings
jilaton.module.wings.description: Layered 3D wings on the upper back with a trailing feather flap.
jilaton.module.halo.name: Halo
jilaton.module.halo.description: A slow-spinning ring above the head with a glowing seal, kept clear of name tags.
jilaton.module.cosmetic_knife.name: Knife
jilaton.module.cosmetic_knife.descriptio: First-person knife with idle sway, walk bob and an equip animation.
jilaton.module.companion.name: Companion
jilaton.module.companion.description: A spring-followed companion that orbits you and banks into turns.
jilaton.module.character-3d.name: 3D Character
jilaton.module.character-3d.description: Replaces your player model with a 3D character.
jilaton.module.block_placement.name: Block Placement
jilaton.module.block_placement.descripti: Temporary wireframe outlines, smooth face glow, and expanding pulses on placed blocks.
jilaton.module.cyberspace.name: Cyberspace
jilaton.module.cyberspace.description: Digital world grid, sonar scan waves, block edge telemetry, and pose-accurate 3D player skeletons.
jilaton.module.glass_material.name: Glass Material
jilaton.module.glass_material.descriptio: Translucent frosted, crystal, obsidian, and holographic 3D glass material shells with Fresnel rim highlights.
jilaton.module.jilaton_gate.name: Jilaton Gate
jilaton.module.jilaton_gate.description: 3D Jilaton-branded obsidian gateway with animated vortex interior and floating 3D emblem.
